state.seed_assertion: A controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.

sentences.1: A controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.2: Where necessary, the controller shall carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.
sentences.3: It is important to reevaluate the DPIA when there is a change of the risk represented by the processing operation.
sentences.4: A DPIA must be kept under review and may need to be repeated if there is a substantial change to the nature, scope, context, or purposes of processing.
sentences.5: We carry out a new DPIA if there is a change to the nature, scope, context or purposes of our processing.
sentences.6: A DPIA should be reevaluated when there is a change in the risk represented by the processing operation due to evolution of technology, use of data for different purposes, or organizational context changes.
sentences.7: If you have determined that the processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of data subjects, you must carry out a data protection impact assessment (DPIA) for each processing operation.
sentences.8: DPIAs should be kept under review and revisited when necessary.
